Alternative names used in citations/search: M. Laaziri; Laaziri Mohamed; Mohamed LAAZIRI

## Profile
Postdoctoral researcher in computational multiphysics, numerical analysis, and scientific computing. Main topics include thermo-hydro-mechanical modeling, fractured porous media, contact mechanics, Virtual Element Methods, Nitsche formulations, Hybrid Finite Volumes, nonlinear solvers, and nuclear-safety applications.

## PhD thesis
- Title: Numerical modelling of thermo-hydro-mechanical processes in fractured porous media
- Author: Mohamed Laaziri
- Preferred reading and sharing version: https://theses.hal.science/tel-05472966v1
